name: voicemsg-frontend
description: Frontend server for Echo Messenger - Multi-Platform Voice Transcription

scripts.deploy:k8s: kubectl apply -k kubernetes/base/ && kubectl apply -f kubernetes/frontend.yaml && kubectl apply -f kubernetes/mtproto-bridge-manager.yaml && kubectl apply -f kubernetes/ingress-nginx.yaml && kubectl apply -f kubernetes/ingress.yaml && (kubectl apply -f kubernetes/eip-ingress.yaml || echo 'Skipping EIP') && kubectl rollout restart deployment echo-frontend -n debugging-testcrash-cloud
